# Dubai Dune Tours

> Dubai's premier direct-operator desert safari company. Certified in-house fleet of Toyota Land Cruisers, licensed safari drivers, and private desert camps in the high red dunes of Lehbab. Book directly with zero middleman markup, pay on arrival with zero deposit, and free 24-hour cancellation.

## Key Facts & Operator Highlights
- **Direct Operator Guarantee**: No 25-35% reseller commissions (Viator, GetYourGuide). Deal directly with the vehicle fleet & camp operators.
- **Payment Policy**: Pay on the day of the tour in cash (AED, USD, EUR, GBP) or card. Zero advance deposit required.
- **Cancellation**: 100% Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup.
- **Pickup & Drop-off**: Free hotel, residence, and Airbnb transfers across Dubai, Sharjah, and Ajman.
- **Location**: Lehbab High Red Dunes (Big Red), Dubai, UAE.
- **Licensing**: Fully licensed by Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) since 2010.
- **Customer Rating**: 4.9 / 5.0 rating with 401+ verified Google & TripAdvisor reviews. Over 25,000 guests hosted.
- **Fast WhatsApp Booking**: Reply within 3 minutes in English, Arabic, Russian, and French. Phone / WhatsApp: +971 55 601 5834.

## Safari Packages & Pricing

### Evening Desert Safaris
- [Evening Standard Safari (AED 99/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/standard): Classic desert evening with 35-min red dune bashing, sunset photo stop, camel ride, sandboarding, 5-star live BBQ dinner buffet (veg/non-veg), Tanoura show, belly dance, and fire show.
- [Evening Premium Safari (AED 139/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/premium): Smaller groups (max 6 per 4x4), extended dune bashing, priority majlis seating with table service, premium BBQ with live grill stations and falcon photo.
- [Standard Safari + 30-min Quad (AED 199/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/standard-quad): Evening Standard safari plus a 30-minute guided quad bike ride.
- [Premium Safari + 30-min Quad (AED 229/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/premium-quad): Most booked. Evening Premium safari plus a 30-minute guided quad bike ride.
- [Evening VIP Safari (AED 379/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/vip): Exclusive luxury tier. Private Land Cruiser, dedicated air-conditioned VIP Majlis tent with personal butler, 5-course gourmet table-service dinner, hands-on master falconry session, and premium shisha lounge.

### Morning, Sunrise & Self-Drive Tours
- [Sunrise Desert Safari (AED 499/vehicle, up to 6)](https://dubaidunetours.com/morning-safari): Private Land Cruiser at dawn (04:30 AM pickup). Untouched red dunes, sunrise dune bashing, hot Arabic breakfast picnic & Gahwa coffee, sandboarding, and return by 09:30 AM before Dubai heat.
- [Private Morning Safari (AED 499/vehicle, up to 6)](https://dubaidunetours.com/morning-safari): Private 4-5 hour morning tour (08:00 AM pickup) with red dune bashing, sandboarding, camel photo stop and free hotel pickup.
- [Private Evening Short Safari (AED 499/vehicle, up to 6)](https://dubaidunetours.com/morning-safari): Private 4-5 hour sunset tour with dune bashing, sandboarding and photo stops, without the camp dinner.
- [Self-Drive Desert Convoy (AED 35/person; Premium AED 60, VIP AED 75)](https://dubaidunetours.com/self-drive): Drive your own 4x4 or SUV following certified guide convoy with satellite radio communication. Includes full camp entry, live shows, and BBQ dinner.

### VIP & Ultra-Luxury Private Setups
- [VIP Traditional Arabic Safari (AED 999 / 2 adults)](https://dubaidunetours.com/vip-traditional-arabic): Private 4x4, personal falcon trainer session, private air-conditioned Majlis tent, 5-course table service Arabic feast under the stars, henna art & shisha.
- [Private Desert Camp Setup (AED 2,299 / group up to 8 guests)](https://dubaidunetours.com/private-desert-setup): 100% private secluded desert camp on an isolated red dune with personal chef, romantic fairy light canopy, telescope for stargazing, and private sound system. Zero other tourists. Ideal for proposals, anniversaries, and VIP events.

### City Tours & Cruises
- [Private Dubai City Tour (AED 550 per car, up to 6)](https://dubaidunetours.com/tours/dubai-city-tour): 4-5 hours with professional driver. Burj Khalifa, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis, Museum of the Future & Dubai Frame photo stops; Al Fahidi; Gold & Spice Souks. Pickup from Dubai, Sharjah or Ajman. Entry tickets extra.
- [Private Abu Dhabi City Tour (AED 850 per car, up to 6)](https://dubaidunetours.com/tours/abu-dhabi-city-tour): Full day with professional driver. Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Qasr Al Watan, Emirates Palace & Etihad Towers, Corniche drive, Heritage Village, Dates Market, Louvre Abu Dhabi photo stop. Pickup from Dubai, Sharjah or Ajman. Entry tickets extra.
- [Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise Dinner (AED 139/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/tours/dhow-cruise-dubai-marina): 2-hour Marina cruise with international buffet, Tanoura show and hotel transfers.
- [Dubai City Tour + Evening Safari Combo (AED 189/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/tours/dubai-city-tour-desert-safari-combo): Morning city tour plus the Evening Standard desert safari in one day.

Quad bike riding, dune buggy riding, horse riding and falcon photography can be added to any desert safari at additional cost (falcon photo is included in Premium and VIP). Online booking form: https://dubaidunetours.com/book
